mapper.insert: insert into project_member( project_member_no, project_no, emp_no, project_member_role, project_member_job ) values ( #{projectMemberNo}, #{projectNo}, #{empNo}, #{projectMemberRole}, #{projectMemberJob} )
mapper.select: select project_member_no, project_no, emp_no, project_member_role, project_member_job from project_member where project_no = #{projectNo} and emp_no = #{empNo}
